Mistfall Hunter - Launch Gameplay Trailer | PS5 Games
Mistfall Hunter is a dark fantasy extraction ARPG set in Weavereach, a shattered world where the gods have perished and the Gyldenmist sweeps the realm. As a Gyldhunter, venture into the heart of the corruption solo or with up to two companions, defeating twisted creatures for their spoils or hunting rival Gyldhunters for their loot. Just be careful: if you die, you lose everything. To secure a safe return to the Windrest, Gyldhunters must track down extraction opportunities hidden within the realm and ring the bell known as Soul of Return to escape. However, the Gyldenmist may conceal more than one way out.

Coming to PlayStation 5 at 6 PM on July 29, 2026. Brave into the Gyldenmist and grab your copy with a 10% launch discount until August 12!

Marvel’s Wolverine - “Deep Cuts” Panel: San Diego Comic-Con 2026 | PS5 Games
https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/marvels-wolverine/

This panel doesn’t just scratch the surface; it cuts through it. Get a behindthe-scenes look at story, characters, and exclusive never-before-seen content from Marvel’s Wolverine. 

Insomniac Games’ creative director Marcus Smith, game director Mike Daly, narrative director Walt Williams, and project director Jess ReinerReed are joined by actors Liam McIntyre (Wolverine) and Krizia Bajos (Jean Grey), along with executive producer Eric Monacelli from Marvel Games, to unveil exciting new details from the highly anticipated Marvel’s Wolverine on PlayStation 5 consoles. 

Marvel’s Wolverine launches September 15, 2026. For more information, visit https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/marvels-wolverine/
